work_history.title: Digital Product Design Manager
work_history.description:
Driving the creation of digital products through hands-on design work, leadership of UI/UX and developer teams, and alignment of business requirements with stakeholders and customer needs.
• Hands-on UI/UX design from concept to prototype, delivering scalable design systems.
• Led and mentored cross-functional teams of 2-12 (mobile and full-stack developers), ensuring outputs meet industry quality standards.
• Worked with stakeholders on investor pitches and product demos to secure funding.
• Delivered product training and walkthroughs with the sales team, translating technical features into user benefits.

work_history.title: Design Director
work_history.description:
Led a team of 2-4 UI/UX designers, oversaw user research, and collaborated on project pitches for a telco group's subsidiary projects.
• UI/UX leadership, user journey walkthroughs, digital product mapping, user requirements gathering, rapid prototyping, creative concepts and UI transitions, system and design solutions.
• Delivered and handed over projects within tight deadlines.

work_history.title: Design Director
work_history.description:
Team lead for most telco client projects, from maintenance to full revamps.
• Led the team on ongoing projects and pitches; guided UI/UX designers, PMs and developers on client requests.
• UI/UX and prototyping (Figma, Draw.io, Miro); compositing and moodboards (Photoshop, Illustrator, Lightroom).
• Worked closely with clients and product owners; weekly development updates internally and externally.

work_history.title: Senior Web Designer
work_history.description:
Executed and launched a telco prepaid microsite in one month.
• Documentation and communication (Word, PowerPoint, Google Workspace, Slack, Keynote).

work_history.title: Junior Web Designer
work_history.description: Managed multiple website maintenance accounts for automotive, beverage and telco brands.
